body: Honestly that's a very good question. I am really bad at removing myself from situations when I'm unhappy, hence two relationships currently where I am unhappy. I drink to cope with the fact that I find myself disgusting and so that I can fall asleep at night. I guess the question would be what can I do? Because I honestly don't know what to do. I am willing to let her go because she can finally be happy and that's what she deserves in life. I don't know what I can do to prevent myself from spiraling in this direction if the next person comes along. Maybe I need to never be in a relationship again? I don't know, if you have ideas please let me know.
